name: Kumasawa Sabakichi
source: Sabakichi Kumasawa is [url=/c366]Kumasawa Chiyo[/url]'s son. He is interviewed by Ange in the world of 1998 when she attempts to discover what killed her family. Ange goes to him to investigate the people living on Nijima that have a connection to the victims. While there she obtains a PIN number, card, and a set of keys labeled A114.
